g.text: WEB02 - SD 5: Display localized allergen names by stable ID
WEB05 page is already authorized under WEB03.
The WEB05 adapter uses approved back-end labels by stable ID.
The allergen API response below is proposed in Q4.
WEB05 and the API owners must confirm it before implementation.
Product and category text, allergens with ID and name
[Allergen labels not already loaded for this view]
Allergen records with ID, name and proposed labels, or error
Available PT/EN labels by stable ID, or source unavailable
Build display data, preserve product and category text
[Each allergen on first render and on locale change]
Display localized name for the same allergen ID
Identify the stored name and explain that translation is unavailable
Render safe localized failure and recovery action
Changing locale selects a label from the current read model.
A missing label remains an AC 3 acceptance gap for that data.
